title: Restriction and trace of a finite etale morphism
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be a finite etale morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and $F$ an abelian sheaf on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. The *restriction* $\operatorname{res}_{f,F}:F\to f_*f^{-1}F$ is the unit $\eta_{f,F}$ of the adjunction $f^{-1}\dashv f_*$ of [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] (direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]). The *trace* $\operatorname{tr}_{f,F}:f_*f^{-1}F\to F$ is the morphism of abelian sheaves given by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-etale-trace-exists]: natural in $F$, compatible with etale localization on $X$, and equal to the sum map $F^{\oplus d}\to F$ when $Y=\coprod_{i=1}^dX$. If $F$ is a sheaf of $R$-modules for a ring $R$, both maps are $R$-linear when $R=\mathbf Z/n$ (additive maps of $\mathbf Z/n$-module sheaves).
